headline: Trump wants to tax AI data centers built abroad
dek: CNBC and The Verge report he said US firms will be barred from building overseas and will face a tax.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: No details yet
body: At a White House press conference on Friday, Trump said US companies will be barred from building data centers abroad and face a "tremendous tax" (CNBC, The Verge).
The Verge says his own staff was caught by surprise. No rate, calculation or date was given.

s3.label: How it works
s3.title: What we know so far
s3.body: What exists is the president's remark, with no rule text.

points.t: Block overseas builds and tax those who try (CNBC).
It came a day after the summit with Xi and Putin (The Verge).
No rate, calculation or date, per The Verge.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Public opinion weighs in
body: A CNBC survey shows most voters oppose an AI data center near their home.
Trump said communities should negotiate benefits, not block projects (CNBC).

items.t: Unclear whether a bill or an executive order will follow.
Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta and Oracle already operate abroad (The Verge).
A Democratic-majority Congress arrives within months (The Verge).

caption.hook: Trump wants to tax AI data centers built outside the US.
body: At a White House press conference on Friday, Trump said US companies will be barred from building data centers in other countries and will face a tax, according to CNBC and The Verge. His staff was caught by surprise, and there was no rate, calculation or date.

The remark came a day after the summit with Xi and Putin in China. A CNBC survey shows 64% of voters oppose an AI data center within 10 miles of home. Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta and Oracle already have sites abroad (The Verge).
